designed_relationships: class A SKUs with promotions show censoring during stockouts: observed sales fall below the published latent demand on stockout days (a lost_sale row records the gap); stockout days of the class A promoted pairs at lost-sale locations: {"prod-001": 5, "prod-002": 74, "prod-004": 10, "prod-005": 82, "prod-007": 27, "prod-008": 49} (synthetic).

supplier sup-03 is late on about 30 % of receipts (31.9% of 254), against sup-01 17.1%, sup-02 13.5%, sup-04 15.8% (late = received after the promised date counted on the supplier calendar; synthetic).

location loc-02 is capacity-bound: storage_capacity is 62% of the summed target positions, so orders are cut to the room left (609 reviews blocked; on hand + on order was at least 90 % of capacity on 548 of 548 days vs 0 at loc-01 and 0 at loc-03; peak on-hand 65% of capacity vs 38% and 38%; synthetic).

parameters.volume_cap: one sale row and one sale movement per SKU x location x day with sales; each SKU is stocked at one home location (60 pairs); only the 8 class-A pairs sell on almost every day, class B/C pairs sell on about 5-60 % of days (rates chosen to stay under the 5 MB budget); latent demand is published for class A, promoted and intermittent pairs, positive days only
